name: finding-row
purpose: One row shape for every detector finding, so findings_gait.py ingests any detector through a thin adapter.

source.doc: detector name: lattice, seedbank or pulse

claim.doc: short class of the finding, such as broken-local-path or flatline

detail.doc: one line of evidence, as the detector printed it

severity.doc: alarm halts attention, warn queues it, info is context

observed_beat.doc: global pulse beat when the finding was ingested

fingerprint.doc: stable id: f- plus ten hex of sha1 of source, claim and detail; the ledger uses it as the finding id
